thread:
Alex Cheng: quick recap from vendor sync — we need to lock SKU tagging rules and driver gating for marketplace listings. H100/H200/B200, MI300, Gaudi all have slightly different firmware/driver dependences. can we list blockers? :calendar:
Priya Gupta: vendor said H200 firmware freeze targeted wk of 2025-05-12, but they flagged a potential microcode patch after that. need decision on whether we accept post-freeze patch as a minor release.
Johan Larsson: B200 thermal derate still a risk for sustained inference loads — ops asked we ship as separate SKU or mark as "burst" profile. that affects marketplace pricing and capacity tags.
Mateo Rosas: from SI integration side — ONNX runtime we test against needs specific driver/nv-ml combos. please confirm the driver version we'll require in the docs. quick check we use during lab runs: ```nvidia-smi --query-gpu=driver_version --format=csv```
Nvidia Liaison Bot: vendor update: H200 firmware freeze = 2025-05-14 UTC; MI300 kernel ABI landing = 2025-05-20; Gaudi board bringup patch ETA = 2025-05-18. All dates tentative.
Amir Patel: comms ask — if any of these slip we must shift embargo and marketplace announce windows by >= 2w to avoid partial availability optics. who owns final embargo handshake with press? @Priya_Gupta? :thinking_face:
Priya Gupta: happy to own the embargo handshake, but need exact SKU list and final driver gating matrix by EOD Friday. will need partner signoff (vendor + SI).
Alex Cheng: action items — 1) Priya to draft embargo commit by Fri EOD; 2) Johan to propose B200 SKU vs burst tag by Thu; 3) Mateo to produce CI matrix with driver versions for ONNX/TF by Thu; 4) @Vendor liaison to confirm any post-freeze patch policy. please react with :white_check_mark: when done.
Johan Larsson: noted, I'll sketch SKU variants and perf caveats, will include sample pricing delta for marketplace.
Mateo Rosas: I'll attach CI matrix to the thread once validated (small CSV + test notes).
Nvidia Liaison Bot: vendor note: post-freeze patches allowed only for security fixes; functional microcode updates require a minor release and may trigger re-cert window.
Alex Cheng: thanks — last ask: if vendor enforces minor-release gating for microcode, we need fallback routing in Redwood runtime (route to H100 or MI300 variants). ops-sre to weigh cost impact. cc: @Amir Patel for comms impact.
Amir Patel: agreed, will draft comms contingency language and embargo slide for execs.
Priya Gupta: locking dependencies doc now — will ping here when ready.
Alex Cheng: perfect — short sync yesterday but important. posting follow-ups in product-announce doc. :thumbsup:
